comments: 5c5f9ba6: ;Call the input transform

8e12971b: ;
Initialize variables: DIE is the global root, DIC is the same as
DIE, DP is the file number, DL is the computed length of the
output field, DIEL is the length of any MUMPS code in the field
definition, DU is any name vector present in the data dictionary.
Also, kill DG, DE, DB which are namespaced variables used by
the input transform.

725fe4d6: ;
If the zero node of the entry exists in the global, get the
12th piece of that node which is the UPLOAD SOURCE field
and store it in the local variable array DE.

9f9e712d: ;
Kill the % namespaced variable used by the UPLOAD SOURCE code.

40fb19e5: ;
Write the prompt for the input transform on the terminal.

58f17d22: ;
Return control to the input transform.

de0078c2: ;
If the field is longer than 19 characters and is not
WORD-PROCESSING and is either a Free Text or a MUMPS
cross-reference, branch to the word-wrapping routine.

a4bf4137: ;
If there is an existing value, write the // delimiter.
If the field is not WORD-PROCESSING and is INQUIRE only,
and an XECUTABLE HELP exists, write "(No Editing)"

0f5f8aee: ;
Read the user's response into the X variable, timing out
if no response is received within the DTIME window.
Set DTOUT=1 if a timeout occurred, else set DTOUT=0.
Write an alarm character if a timeout occurred.
db9f16e7: Quit if called with no arguments.
7108661d: Initialize the data queue and increment the queue index.
193472a9: Branch to the entry point identified by the queue index.
fb414af3: If there is data in the DE array for the current queue index, execute the PR routine, then execute the W and TR routines.
1d21d204: If X is empty, and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to A. If X is non-empty and DV is empty, go to X. If X is non-empty and D is negative or zero, go to X. Otherwise, go to A.
28a96123: If X is a question mark, go to QS. If X starts with '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
c9eb915c: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.

8ce984bf: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and there is data in ^DISV for the current user, device, and logic block, set X to the value stored there. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write X with a leading space.

46999570: If DV is not empty, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If there is executable code at ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute it. Set % to the portion of DU after the semicolon and X, and set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If the result is true and DB(DQ) is undefined, write % with a leading space, then go to V.
ca22d708: If the data piece does not contain the word being searched for, quit processing
7f248875: If there is no local potential array, write the remainder of the data piece and store the actual word
60d4ab4b: If the data validation instructs a lookup (DV contains 'P'), set up the lookup call parameters and perform the lookup, storing the returned IEN. If the lookup fails, quit.
4878a4c1: If data validation does not allow numeric input (DV does not contain 'N'), check for a value and quit if too long
a4434f8e: If the data type is numeric with decimal places allowed, remove unnecessary trailing 0s and decimal point
4dea839e: If variable YS is defined kill it
4acfc600: Kill certain fields, like DIC("S"), DLAYGO. If X is defined and not null, set DG(DW)=X. Also, if DV contains 'd' set ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB)=X
048de7b6: If DB(DQ) is defined, branch to Z^DIE17, otherwise write bell character and '??'
f7e86443: Set X to the string '?BAD'
7873edea: Set DZ=X, execute D routine, call QQ^DIEQ and branch to B
84a9baf1: Set D=DIFLD, DQ(DQ) to concatenation of DLB, DV, DU, DW and piece of @("X"_DQ) routine
8435ae72: If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute O routine. If X is not '@', branch to RD. If DV doesn't contain 'R' and X='@', branch to A. If X='@', set X=Y and branch to N
89137e83: Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute it and branch to RP
0667e266: If DG contains 'P' and ^(X_"0")) node exists, set X to value at ^(0). If ^(Y,0) is undefined, branch to RP. Otherwise, set Y and X from ^(0), DG from ^DD(X,.01,0) and repeat R

740fb1fd: If DG contains 'V', Y is non-zero, $P(Y,";",2) contains '(' and @(U_$P(Y,";",2)_"0")) exists, set X to value at ^(0). If ^(+Y,0) undefined, branch to RP. Set Y from ^(0). If ^DD(+X,.01,0) exists, set DG and X from ^(0) and repeat R
404c142e: If DG contains 'D', execute ^DD("DD"). If DG contains 'S', set Y to $P($P(";"_X,";"+Y+":",2),";"). If Y is not null, set Y=Y
